items.title: Reduce generic cloud routing labels
items.reason: Too many executions still resolve as generic cloud instead of specific service.
items.suggested_action: Prefer direct service stamping in runtime and keep trace rebuild active.

items.title: Eliminate unknown service failures
items.reason: Unknown service failures still appear in telemetry.
items.suggested_action: Strengthen service resolver fallback and keep force_specific_service_resolution enabled.

items.title: Improve Claude payload compatibility
items.reason: Repeated Claude 400 errors are still present.
items.suggested_action: Keep anthropic_safe_mode on and validate candidate payload shapes before invoke.

items.title: Keep n8n rollout guarded
items.reason: n8n still has failures and should remain gated until verify/test are stable.
items.suggested_action: Do not promote live until verify_api and dry-run webhook both succeed.

items.title: Complete n8n connector config
items.reason: n8n still is not fully configured.
items.suggested_action: Persist webhook_path and ensure n8n is reachable on the configured base_url.

items.title: Reduce active snapshot pressure
items.suggested_action: Keep aggressive cleanup and archive completed missions earlier.

actions: Enabled anthropic_safe_mode and active Claude payload profile safe_inline due to repeated Claude 400 errors.
Confirmed openai_endpoint_compatibility due to fallback/failure signal.
Kept force_specific_service_resolution enabled because unknown-service failures exist.
